rules: Prefer the lightest tool that answers the question.
Use stock_search first when code/name is ambiguous.
Do not call provider_health unless diagnosing upstream issues.

The default retail_v1_preview profile exposes only stock_search, market_brief, stock_snapshot, stock_quote, stock_history, stock_review, watchlist_review, trading_calendar, sector_review, and hot_theme_tracker; confirm tool_profile=full before using other tools.

Always show source and freshness/as_of when available, identify unknown or partial data, and say that results are data reference only and not investment advice; never give buy/sell, profit, or stock-pick conclusions.
For sector_lookup with mode=children or members, require explicit sector_type=primary|concept.
Use market_pool for light snapshots; only use limit_up_pool for deeper short-term sentiment/history.
Start sector_rotation_review with small limit and prefer skip_member_detail=true when stock-level detail is unnecessary.
